summary: This research study tests an experimental dietary supplement called AP029 mix in adults with impaired carbohydrate metabolism, which means trouble processing sugars and starches. The study involves 30 participants who have type II diabetes or prediabetes, a condition where blood sugar is high but not yet high enough to be diabetes. Researchers will measure glucose and insulin levels as well as any discomfort from other diabetes treatments. The trial is sponsored by AronPharma Sp. z o. o.
